COST: 445

Notes on the plan:
- Driving totals 265 minutes (car1: 10, car2: 255). Deferrals total 180 (4 adults at Tarkeshwar farm, 80; 2 elderly at Shivapuri care home, 100).
- Everyone else is rescued: all 3 Kakani temple shopkeepers, all 4 Gajuri schoolchildren, both Jwalamukhi children, all 5 Syaphru elderly, all 6 Myagang adults, and the 3 Gajuri adults.
- Shivapuri care home is only reachable from the Kakani side. Car1 could fetch those two elderly, but the 110-minute round trip costs more than the 100-minute deferral penalty, so I deferred them.
- I treated the Kakani temple to Dhunche temple road as unusable, since fast floodwater swept a truck off it. If it is confirmed safe, it does not improve this plan.
- Dhunche temple is not used as a drop-off point because it has not been designated as one.
